audit_refactor: Audited sync_session_resume_transfer_workorders and found that rev0688 used INSERT OR REPLACE, allowing a second worker to overwrite a live claimed row under the same session/path/chunk primary key.

Added claim_sync_session_checkpoint_resume_transfer_workorders so a worker can persist claimed transfer rows and return without writing staged bytes, receipt sidecars, receipt rows, or file-result counters.
Refactored the fake-peer executor and claim-only API through a shared claim/probe helper using INSERT OR IGNORE followed by a full row reload.

The shared helper requires claimed state, matching worker id, worker lease id, worker lease epoch, peer identity, request keys, execution key, chunk evidence, and staging path before execution proceeds.
Extended the sync-domain selftest to prove claim-only rows are crash-visible, action routing remains ResumeTransfer, mismatched worker execution fails, and the owning worker can complete the rows.
Audit correction: the named boundary is claim-only resume transfer workorders, not a completed transfer proof; executor claims are no longer stealable through INSERT OR REPLACE.
claim_split_checks: claim-only API persists sync_session_resume_transfer_workorders rows in work_state claimed
claim-only API does not write staged bytes or receipt sidecars
claim-only API does not promote the action plan to MaterializeStagedFile
executor no longer uses INSERT OR REPLACE for workorder claims
executor rejects another worker or lease attempting to execute a live claimed row
owning worker/lease can execute preclaimed rows and mark them completed
heart_of_mission: authorized peer-to-peer folder convergence under evidence-bound local truth
known_limits: No claimed-at timestamp, lease-expiry timestamp, retry-at timestamp, attempt counter, abandon state, or quarantine reason is implemented yet.
Expired-lease reclaim is not implemented; mismatched workers are rejected rather than allowed to reclaim under policy.
Production peer transport and authenticated peer response acceptance are still future work.
Overwrite replay, tombstone replay, conflict replay, trust material, and metadata privacy policy remain open.
Rev0690 deliberately stops before abandoned-lease semantics: it can persist and protect a live claim, but cannot yet expire, reclaim, abandon, or quarantine stale leases.

recommended_next_code_revision.acceptance_target: fresh claimed rows cannot be reclaimed; expired claimed rows can be reclaimed by a new worker with previous-owner evidence preserved; abandoned/quarantined rows remain auditable; owned execution still rejects mismatched fresh claims

summary: Adds claim-only resume transfer workorders through a public claim API, refactors row ownership through a non-stealing claim/probe helper, and proves mismatched workers cannot steal live claimed rows before fake-peer execution.
